title: An Easy Pace on the Hill
story: After a tight calf, Omar's coach cut his evening run in half and banned hills for two weeks. Omar was annoyed, because a charity race was a month away and he hated losing fitness. The coach said fitness could return, but a tear would cost him the race entirely. Omar followed the plan, added gentle stretches, and swam on the days when running was forbidden. By the second week the calf felt looser in the morning. He still wanted to sprint, yet he waited. When the coach finally allowed a short hill, Omar kept his pace easy and finished without pain.

vocabulary.definition: The muscle at the back of the lower leg.
Officially stopped for a period of time.
Gentle movements that lengthen a muscle.
Run at full speed for a short burst.

quiz.question: What limit did the coach set after the tight calf?
options: He cut the evening run in half and banned hills for two weeks
He cancelled the charity race that month
He told Omar to sprint up hills every day
He banned swimming as well as running
quiz.correctAnswer: He cut the evening run in half and banned hills for two weeks
quiz.explanation: After the tight calf, the coach halved the evening run and banned hills for two weeks.
quiz.supportingSentence: After a tight calf, Omar's coach cut his evening run in half and banned hills for two weeks.

quiz.question: What does the swimming suggest about Omar?
options: He ignored the plan and ran the hills anyway
He stayed active without breaking the ban on running
He gave up every kind of exercise
He swam only after the charity race was over
quiz.correctAnswer: He stayed active without breaking the ban on running
quiz.explanation: He swam on days when running was forbidden, so he kept moving while obeying the limit.
quiz.supportingSentence: Omar followed the plan, added gentle stretches, and swam on the days when running was forbidden.

quiz.question: Why was Omar annoyed by the new plan?
options: The coach had cancelled the charity race
The stretches made his calf worse each morning
A charity race was near and he hated losing fitness
Swimming was banned for the whole month
quiz.correctAnswer: A charity race was near and he hated losing fitness
quiz.explanation: He was annoyed because the charity race was a month away and he hated losing fitness.
quiz.supportingSentence: Omar was annoyed, because a charity race was a month away and he hated losing fitness.

quiz.question: What does the easy pace on the hill suggest?
options: He sprinted as soon as the hill was allowed
The coach refused to let him finish
The pain returned before he reached the top
He held back even after a harder effort was allowed
quiz.correctAnswer: He held back even after a harder effort was allowed
quiz.explanation: When a short hill was finally allowed, he kept the pace easy, so he did not use the permission to sprint.
quiz.supportingSentence: When the coach finally allowed a short hill, Omar kept his pace easy and finished without pain.

quiz.question: What does forbidden mean in this story?
options: Not allowed under the coach's plan
Especially enjoyable for a runner
Done at full speed
Certain to heal a muscle overnight
quiz.correctAnswer: Not allowed under the coach's plan
quiz.explanation: Running was forbidden on some days, which means the plan did not allow it then.
quiz.supportingSentence: Omar followed the plan, added gentle stretches, and swam on the days when running was forbidden.
